claim: Region and city resolve on live traffic from 2026-08-13 via GeoLite2-City; nothing earlier carries a region. The variable is MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY and a wrong name fails SILENTLY back to country-only.

body.decision: DEC-283 / DAL-251 (2026-08-13). SHIPPED. Benedict created the MaxMind account; region and city now resolve on live traffic.
body.status: Live since 2026-08-13 02:52 UTC. Loaded database is GeoLite2-City (was DBIP-Country-Lite). visit:region returns ISO 3166-2 Australian states, visit:city returns geonames ids.
body.why_country_works_and_region_does_not: Plausible CE ships with DB-IP Country Lite baked in. That is the source of visit:country. It is a country-only file with no region data. Nothing was misconfigured; the capability was never present.
body.v3_2_0_supports: IP_GEOLOCATION_DB, MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY, MAXMIND_EDITION, GEONAMES_SOURCE_FILE (grepped from the running image). Geonames name table already bundled at /app/lib/location-0.1.0/priv/geonames.lite.csv.
body.how_it_is_wired: /opt/dale/secrets/maxmind.env (mode 600) holds MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY and MAXMIND_EDITION=GeoLite2-City. It is referenced as an env_file on the plausible service in /opt/dale/plausible/docker-compose.yml, so the secret never enters the compose file. Plausible downloads the database itself and auto-updates it; there is no mmdb in the backup set and no refresh script.
body.the_variable_name_is_load_bearing: Plausible reads MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY. The name Benedict supplied was MAXMIND_KEY. A wrong name does NOT crash the container: ip_geolocation_db falls back to the bundled dbip-country.mmdb.gz, so it boots, serves country data, and visit:region stays silently empty. Caught before the restart by grepping the running image and reading /app/releases/0.0.1/runtime.exs:249-252.
body.db_ip_city_lite_does_not_work: Free, CC BY, no signup, loads fine, and resolves correctly in-process (58.7.0.1 -> Western Australia / Perth). But the Lite file is stripped: subdivisions carry names only, no iso_code, and city carries names only, no geoname_id. Plausible stores region as ISO 3166-2 and city as a geonames id, so it has nothing to store. Verified by pushing one real pageview through /api/event with X-Forwarded-For: 58.7.0.1: country resolved to AU, region and city both empty.
body.no_backfill: Region data starts 2026-08-13. Nothing before that date carries a region. DAL-249's state choice gets a usable sample a few weeks out; do not read the first days as representative.
body.verification: Front-door test per DEC-270, not an in-process lookup. Three pageviews through /api/event with X-Forwarded-For 58.7.0.1, 1.128.0.1, 144.6.1.1 on walkthrough.au returned visit:region AU-NT, AU-QLD, AU-NSW, matching the database exactly, and visit:city 2073124 (Darwin) and 2147714 (Sydney). Real traffic confirmed separately: treestock.com.au showed AU-QLD visitors within four minutes of the restart.
body.test_artefacts: Two deliberate artefacts on walkthrough.au, the only zero-traffic site on the instance: /dal-251-geoip-test (2026-08-06, DEC-270) and /dal-251-maxmind-test (2026-08-13, 3 views). Both kept rather than removed with a hand-written ALTER TABLE DELETE on the events table, which is the larger risk.
